measurementProtocol.lighthouse: Median of three Lighthouse mobile navigation runs against a clean local production preview; category scores are recorded as integers from 0 to 100.
measurementProtocol.visualVerdict: Arithmetic mean of strict 0-100 visual verdicts for 1280x720 desktop and 390x844 mobile screenshots.
measurementProtocol.binaryChecks: A check receives credit only when its full wording is satisfied and evidence is recorded; partial credit is not allowed.
measurementProtocol.passingRule: The unrounded weighted total must be strictly greater than 98.5.

visualVerdict.description: Rendered desktop and mobile hierarchy, restraint, rhythm, legibility, and category fit, scored from 0 to 100.
